$comment: Single source of truth for the Switch API. Every framework package is tested against this file.
name: switch
title: Switch
description: Turn a setting on or off straight away.
thumb: Wi-FiBluetooth

label.description: Visible label, linked to the switch. Without it, pass an aria-label.

description.description: Smaller text under the label, read out with the switch.

controlPosition.description: Put the switch after the text, full width (settings rows).

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: A checkbox with role="switch": it works without JavaScript and submits with forms. Uses the same label layout as Checkbox.

examples.title: Settings list
examples.description: Put the switch at the end of the row and add a description for each setting.

examples.title: Small and disabled
examples.description: A smaller switch for dense layouts. Disabled switches keep their state visible.

a11y: A native checkbox with role="switch": screen readers say "on" or "off", and Space toggles it.
Every switch has a label: a <label for> or an aria-label.
Use a switch for settings that take effect at once; use a Checkbox inside forms that are submitted.
Visible focus ring in every style and mode; the on state is not shown by colour alone (the knob moves).
